# openai_tenant_workload_identity_federation_rules (Data Source)

Beta. List tenant workload identity federation rules, following pagination. Requires tenant.workload_identity.read. Typed summaries omit arbitrary JSON fields; response_json contains the complete responses.

Authentication: Set the tenant_admin_api_key provider attribute or OPENAI_TENANT_ADMIN_KEY environment variable for the tenant API audience; with a custom tenant_base_url, set the tenant_admin_api_key provider attribute explicitly.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openai_tenant_workload_identity_federation_rules" "example" {
  workload_identity_provider_id = "workload_identity_provider_123"
}
```
